name: Kevin Da Costa Stateri
title: Junior Developer
tagline: Python, REST APIs, PHP & Payment Integrations
rightToWork: Right to work in the UK: Yes (EU Settled Status)
profile: Junior Developer with commercial backend experience since January 2025 and a BSc in Computer Science (2:1). Builds and maintains server-side features for e-commerce systems, including legacy platform migrations and payment gateway integrations (Worldpay, SagePay/Opayo), working from provider specifications and documenting APIs with OpenAPI/Swagger. Python (Flask) experience from academic projects includes a Bearer-token-authenticated REST API and a machine learning model. Returning to Leicestershire and looking for a remote engineering role.

bullets: Build and maintain backend features for client e-commerce systems in PHP (MVC) and MySQL, taking change requests and bug reports through email and an issue tracker, then implementing and releasing them.
Migrated legacy platforms from version 1.5 to 3.0, investigating configuration and data-integrity issues and refactoring PHP to current standards while preserving product, order and customer data.
Upgraded payment gateway integrations from SagePay protocol v3 to Opayo protocol v4, working independently from the provider's technical specification.
Rolled back a payment API upgrade to restore a live website after an undocumented provider change caused errors, then contacted the provider's support team to get the fault fixed at source.
Implemented Worldpay hosted payment pages in checkout workflows, with secure request handling and validation of transaction responses.
Built secure API integrations and kept structured documentation up to date in OpenAPI/Swagger so others can understand and support the work.
Develop and deploy in Linux server environments, using Git, code review and controlled deployments to release changes safely.
